cases.question: How much does a consultation cost?
cases.answer: General consultation: Rs 500. Free if you book a treatment the same day. Second-opinion consultation (bring your old X-rays and treatment plan): Rs 500. [1]

cases.question: What is the price of scaling and polishing?
cases.answer: Scaling and polishing costs Rs 1,500 per session. [1]

cases.question: How much is laser teeth whitening?
cases.answer: Laser teeth whitening costs Rs 12,000 for one 60-minute session. [1]

cases.question: Do you have a take-home whitening kit and what does it cost?
cases.answer: Yes, we offer a take-home whitening kit for Rs 6,500. [1]

cases.question: Root canal price for a molar?
cases.answer: Root canal treatment (molar): Rs 8,000. Crown is charged separately. [1]

cases.question: How much is a zirconia crown?
cases.answer: Zirconia crown: Rs 14,000. [1]

cases.question: What do metal braces cost?
cases.answer: Metal braces: from Rs 35,000 for the full course. [1]

cases.question: Clear aligners price?
cases.answer: Clear aligners: from Rs 90,000. Final price after a 3D scan. [1]

cases.question: How much is a check-up for my 8 year old child?
How much does a dental implant cost?
cases.answer: The cost of a single dental implant with crown is Rs 30,000 for the Korean system or Rs 55,000 for the Swiss system (Straumann), and the CBCT scan is charged separately at Rs 3,000. [1][3]

cases.question: What is the price of wisdom tooth extraction?
cases.answer: Wisdom tooth extraction (erupted): Rs 2,500. Wisdom tooth surgical removal (impacted): Rs 6,000 to Rs 12,000, depending on the X-ray. [1]

cases.question: How much is a tooth coloured filling?
cases.answer: Tooth-coloured composite filling: Rs 1,200 per tooth. [1]

cases.question: What does a full mouth X-ray cost?
cases.answer: Full mouth X-ray (OPG) costs Rs 700. [1]

cases.question: Price of complete dentures for both jaws?
Where is the clinic located?
cases.answer: We are at 14, 2nd Avenue, Anna Nagar, Chennai 600040, above the Canara Bank branch. [1]

cases.question: Is there parking for cars?
cases.answer: Car parking is on the side street. [1]

cases.question: What are your opening hours on Saturday?
cases.answer: Monday to Saturday: 9:30 AM to 1:30 PM and 4:30 PM to 8:30 PM. [1]

cases.question: Are you open on Sunday?
cases.answer: Yes, we are open on Sunday from 10:00 AM to 1:00 PM for emergencies only. [1]

cases.question: Can I pay using UPI?
cases.answer: Yes, UPI is accepted as a payment method. [1]

cases.question: Is EMI available for braces?
cases.answer: No-cost EMI is available on braces and aligners through Bajaj Finserv. [1]

cases.question: Do you accept insurance?
cases.answer: We do not bill insurance directly; we provide an itemised invoice for you to claim reimbursement from your insurer. [1]

cases.question: Does the doctor speak Tamil?
cases.answer: Yes, the doctors speak Tamil. [1]

cases.question: Which doctor handles orthodontics and aligners?
cases.answer: Dr. Priya Raman (BDS, MDS) — orthodontics, braces and aligners. [1]

cases.question: I have severe tooth pain, what should I do?
cases.answer: For severe tooth pain, call +91 98400 00000. We keep two emergency slots every day. [1]

cases.question: How late can I cancel my appointment?
cases.answer: You can cancel or reschedule at least 4 hours before your appointment. [1]

cases.question: What happens if I miss appointments without telling you?
cases.answer: If you miss an appointment without informing us twice, we ask for a Rs 500 advance for your next booking, which is adjusted in your bill. [1]

cases.question: What if I arrive late for my appointment?
cases.answer: If you are more than 15 minutes late, we may need to move you to the next free slot. [1]

cases.question: What should I bring on my first visit?
cases.answer: Please bring any previous X-rays and a list of medicines you take. [2]

cases.question: Can I book on WhatsApp?
cases.answer: Yes, you can book an appointment on WhatsApp. [1]

cases.question: How many visits does a root canal take?
cases.answer: Most root canals are done in 1 or 2 visits of about 60 minutes each. [2]
citations: treatments.md › How many visits does a root canal take

cases.question: Does a root canal hurt?
cases.answer: The tooth is fully numbed with local anaesthesia, so most patients feel pressure, not pain. Mild soreness for 2 to 3 days afterwards is normal. [2]
citations: treatments.md › Does a root canal hurt

cases.question: When is the implant crown fitted?
cases.answer: The implant crown is fitted after 3 to 4 months, once the implant has bonded with the bone. [1]

cases.question: What should I avoid after a tooth extraction?
cases.answer: Do not spit, rinse or use a straw for 24 hours. [1]

cases.question: I am pregnant, is a dental cleaning safe?
cases.answer: Check-ups and cleaning are safe during pregnancy, ideally in the second trimester. [1]

cases.question: I am very nervous about the dentist. Can you help?
cases.answer: Yes, we can help nervous patients by offering longer appointments, explaining every step before treatment starts, and allowing you to raise your hand to pause at any time. Please let us know about your anxiety when you book so we can accommodate your needs. [1]

cases.question: My gums bleed when I brush. What should I do?
cases.answer: Bleeding gums are usually an early sign of gum disease. A scaling session and better brushing often fix it. Book a check-up if bleeding lasts more than a week. [1]
